hook: How is LeBron James connected to Kim Jong Un?
title: How is LeBron James connected to Kim Jong Un?
description: Five real photos connect LeBron James to North Korea's Kim Jong Un, through Kobe Bryant, two American presidents and South Korea's president.

links.line: In 2016, LeBron James faced Kobe Bryant during Kobe's final season.

image.file: File:Kobe Bryant and Barack Obama Dec 2015.jpg

links.line: A few months earlier, Kobe dropped by the Oval Office to see President Obama.

image.file: File:Obama hands over presidency to Trump at 58th Presidential Inauguration 170120-D-NA975-0947.jpg

links.line: In 2017, Obama handed the presidency to Donald Trump.

image.file: File:President Donald J. Trump welcomes President Moon Jae-in of the Republic of Korea to the White House (35520219101).jpg

links.line: That summer, Trump hosted South Korea's president at the White House.
And in 2018, he met Kim Jong Un at the border between the two Koreas.
